assumptions: GSLE has no public source release on the author project page at implementation time.
Initialization point count/scale use GSGen defaults; low color/radial opacity constants are implementation choices because GSLE does not publish them.
Densification periods, opacity pruning threshold, camera elevation/radius range, inpainting settings and SDS timestep limits are exposed implementation choices, not reported GSLE constants.
AVP paper prose and supplement pseudocode disagree; both scores and selections are saved, text-consistent directional contrast drives this run.
Coarse iterations use the supplement hardware section's 6500; an intermediate 3500 checkpoint is also saved.

CFG for DI-SDS follows paper Eq7: conditioned+s*(conditioned-unconditioned). Its unconditional expression omits all conditions; implement empty text and zero mask/context/depth residuals, padding to the required nine UNet channels. The paper does not specify this channel-padding detail.

Use the published physical batches when memory permits; --microbatch may accumulate the same effective batch on the shared GPU. Frozen-background shading and depth conditions are outside autograd without changing joint visibility.
